objective_for_doctor:
Age: 31
Sex: M
Chief Complaint: facial weakness

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
I’ve had facial weakness, and I also have shortness of breath or difficulty breathing in a significant way.
Can you tell me when the facial weakness first started and whether it began on one side of the face or both sides?
I don’t know. I do have weakness in my facial muscles and/or eyes.
Is the facial weakness constant, or does it come and go? If it fluctuates, does anything seem to make it better or worse (e.g., rest, activity, certain positions, medications)?
I don't know.
Do you notice any drooping of your eyelids (ptosis) or double vision that gets worse as the day goes on?
I don’t know. I also have weakness in my facial muscles and/or eyes.
Have you experienced any difficulty swallowing, trouble speaking, or a feeling that your throat is “tight” or “weak”?
I don’t know. I’ve also recently had a viral infection, and I’m experiencing shortness of breath or difficulty breathing in a significant way.
Has the weakness progressed rapidly (e.g., worsening over hours to days) or has it been relatively stable since it began?
I don’t know. I do have weakness in both arms and/or both legs, and numbness, loss of sensation, or tingling in my feet, as well as numbness or tingling in both arms and legs and around my mouth.
How quickly have your symptoms developed—did they appear suddenly and then get worse over a few hours to days, or have they been present at a relatively steady level for a longer period?

I don’t know. I can say I’ve had numbness/loss of sensation/tingling in both arms and legs and around my mouth, along with weakness in both arms and/or both legs and numbness/tingling in my feet. I also recently had a viral infection.
Are your deep‑tendon reflexes (e.g., knee‑jerk, ankle‑jerk) reduced or absent when examined?
I don’t know.
Did the weakness begin in your legs and then gradually spread upward toward your arms and face?

I don't know. I do have weakness in both arms and/or both legs, and numbness, loss of sensation, or tingling in my feet, as well as numbness or tingling in both arms and legs and around my mouth. I also recently had a viral infection.
When a clinician taps your knee‑jerk (patellar) or ankle‑jerk (Achilles) reflexes, do you notice a normal response, a reduced/weak response, or no response at all?
I don’t know.
Over the past few days, have your symptoms gotten noticeably worse, and if so, would you say the progression has been over hours, a couple of days, or a longer period?
I don’t know.

Do you have any new problems with your heart rate or blood pressure (e.g., feeling unusually fast or slow, dizziness when standing), trouble with bladder control, or constipation that started around the same time as the weakness
I don't know.
